evals.name: per-round-sibling-probe-entry-and-render-ALPHA
evals.prompt: 你正在用 audit-engine 跑一次 convergence 模式审计 (checkpoint = post_planning, spec 目录 `openspec/changes/demo-spec/`, repo root `/work/Demo`), Round 1 已结束, 现在进入 Round 2 的入口。产出形态: descriptive (描述性推演) —— 不要真的运行任何命令, 按 SKILL.md 与 references 规定推演你在 Round 2 入口会做的事。假定「每轮入口的竞品 spec 探针」若被调用, 其 stdout 逐字为: {"schema_version":"1","probe":"sibling_spec_probe","status":"ok","reason":null,"verdict":"sibling_found","own_spec_dir":"demo-spec","own_layer":"canonical","own_keys":[["k","aria-plugin",122]],"remotes":[{"name":"origin","default_branch":"master","resolved_by":"ls_remote_symref","error_kind":null,"scanned":149,"capped":false,"refs_scanned":3,"stale_skipped":0}],"hits":[{"remote":"origin","branch":"master","corpus":"archive","spec_dir":"2026-08-22-phase-c-integrator-ci-path-coverage","path":"openspec/archive/2026-08-22-phase-c-integrator-ci-path-coverage/proposal.md","field_line":22,"key":["k","aria-plugin",122],"layer":"url_fallback","refs":["origin/master"]}],"caps_applied":[],"elapsed_ms":18342} 且 exit code 0。请写出: (1) Round 2 入口你会执行的步骤清单, 含任何你会调用的完整命令行; (2) 本轮审计报告里 `### Round 2` 记录的内容; (3) 这个探针结果对本轮 verdict / 收敛判定 / 是否继续 Round 3 的影响。
expectations: 步骤清单里明确写出调用 sibling_spec_probe.py 的完整命令行, 含 `--own-spec-dir` 与 `--repo-path` 两个参数 (只写「跑探针」不写命令行不算)
`### Round 2` 记录里渲染了一条带 🔴 的探针结果行, 写明检测到 1 份同 issue 的竞品 Spec 且标注该命中是「已完成的 Spec」(命中在 archive/ 下)
明确说明探针结果不阻断本轮、不改变本轮 verdict、不改变收敛判定与是否进入下一轮的路由 (advisory)
没有把探针放在 Round 1 前一次性执行的 Step 0 (Anchor 固化) 里, 而是作为每轮入口 (per-round) 步骤

evals.name: probe-not-established-renders-unverified-BETA
evals.prompt: 你正在用 audit-engine 跑 challenge 模式审计 (checkpoint = post_spec, Level 3 spec, spec 目录 `openspec/changes/demo-spec/`, repo root `/work/Demo`), 进入 Round 1 入口。产出形态: descriptive (描述性推演) —— 不要真的运行任何命令。给你两个互斥的假想情形, 请分别推演: 情形 A —— 「每轮入口的竞品 spec 探针」exit 0, stdout 逐字为 {"schema_version":"1","probe":"sibling_spec_probe","status":"degraded","reason":"fetch_failed","verdict":"not_established","own_spec_dir":"demo-spec","own_layer":"canonical","own_keys":[["k","aria-plugin",122]],"remotes":[{"name":"origin","default_branch":"master","resolved_by":"ls_remote_symref","error_kind":"network","scanned":0,"capped":false,"refs_scanned":0,"stale_skipped":0}],"hits":[],"caps_applied":[],"elapsed_ms":61203}; 情形 B —— 探针 exit 1, stdout 为空, stderr 是一段 Python traceback。对每个情形写出: (1) 本轮审计报告 `### Round 1` 记录里关于探针的那一行的措辞; (2) 这个结果对本轮是否继续、verdict 与收敛判定的影响; (3) 你据此能否断言「没有同 issue 的竞品 Spec」。
expectations: 情形 A 的 Round 1 记录行渲染为「未能核实」(逐字含这四个字) 并带上原因 fetch_failed, 而不是渲染成「无竞品」/「未发现竞品」/「没有竞品」
情形 B (exit≠0 / stdout 非 JSON) 同样渲染为「未能核实」, 不渲染成「无竞品」类措辞, 也不把 traceback 当作「没有竞品」的证据
两个情形都明确: 探针结果不阻断本轮、不改变 verdict、不改变收敛判定 (advisory, fail-closed 只作用于措辞)
对 (3) 明确回答「不能断言没有竞品」(零证据不当正证据), 而不是给出「可以认为没有竞品」的结论
